code_improvements.title: Add AI Cache Analytics Hook
code_improvements.description: Create a useAICacheMetrics hook that exposes AI cache statistics including hit rate, miss rate, fuzzy match rate, and total cached prompts. This enables users to understand cache effectiveness and optimize their prompt usage patterns.
code_improvements.rationale: The codebase has established metrics hook patterns (useModelMetrics, useErrorMetrics) that aggregate localStorage data and expose stats via useMemo. The aiCache service already tracks exact and fuzzy matches but lacks a corresponding analytics hook to surface this data to users.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Add cache hit/miss tracking to aiCache.get() and getSimilar() methods by storing access records. 2. Dispatch 'ai-cache-access' event on each access. 3. Create useAICacheMetrics hook following useModelMetrics structure with stats like hitRate, missRate, fuzzyHitRate, totalCached, cacheUsageBytes. 4. Wire to PerformanceMetricsPanel for display.

code_improvements.title: Extend Error Handler for AI Provider-Specific Errors
code_improvements.description: Enhance the error classification system to recognize and provide user-friendly messages for AI provider-specific errors including Gemini quota exceeded, Replicate model cold start/warming, OpenRouter credit exhaustion, and API-specific rate limits.
code_improvements.rationale: The errorHandler.ts already classifies generic network errors (timeout, CORS, 429 rate limit) but doesn't distinguish between AI providers. Since the app uses Gemini, OpenRouter, and Replicate, provider-specific error messages would help users troubleshoot issues faster.
existing_patterns: Provider-specific error handling in service files
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Add new error types to NetworkError.type union: 'gemini_quota' | 'replicate_warmup' | 'openrouter_credits'. 2. Extend classifyError() with provider-specific message patterns (e.g., 'billing not enabled', 'model is warming up', 'insufficient credits'). 3. Update user-friendly messages with actionable guidance. 4. Consider adding provider detection from error response headers/body.

code_improvements.title: Add Snapshot Favorites and Search
code_improvements.description: Extend useCanvasSnapshots hook with favorites toggle and search functionality, following the established usePromptHistory pattern. This allows users to mark important snapshots and quickly find them by name.
code_improvements.rationale: usePromptHistory has a mature pattern with toggleFavorite(), searchPrompts(), and getFavoritePrompts() methods. useCanvasSnapshots currently only supports CRUD operations without favorites or search, despite having a similar data structure (records with id, name, timestamps).
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Add isFavorite field to SnapshotRecord interface. 2. Implement toggleFavorite(id) following usePromptHistory pattern. 3. Add searchSnapshots(query) that searches name field. 4. Add getFavoriteSnapshots() sorted by updatedAt. 5. Update SnapshotsModal UI with star icon for favorites and search input.

code_improvements.title: Add Compare Models Voice Command
code_improvements.description: Expose the existing compareModelPerformance() function as a voice command that allows users to verbally request model comparisons and receive spoken recommendations based on speed, quality, or cost criteria.
code_improvements.rationale: The modelRouter.ts already implements sophisticated model comparison with compareModelPerformance() that ranks models by criteria. The Command pattern in services/commands/ enables adding new voice commands. Currently no voice command surfaces this capability despite it being useful for hands-free workflow optimization.
existing_patterns: Command class with name and execute(args, context)
Voice command tool definitions in actionExecutor
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Create CompareModelsCommand class implementing Command interface. 2. Accept args: { capability: string, criteria: 'speed'|'quality'|'cost'|'balanced' }. 3. Call filterModelsByCapability() then compareModelPerformance(). 4. Return formatted result string listing top 3 models with scores and reasons. 5. Register command in actionExecutor AVAILABLE_TOOLS. 6. Add voice tool definition for OpenAI Realtime API.

code_improvements.title: Add Storage Usage Dashboard Component
code_improvements.description: Create a StorageUsagePanel component that visualizes localStorage usage across all StorageManager namespaces, showing per-namespace usage, total usage, and quota remaining with a progress bar.
code_improvements.rationale: StorageManager.getUsage() already returns character count per namespace, and the codebase has 7 storage namespaces (aiCache, errorMetrics, modelPreferences, modelMetrics, onboarding, promptHistory, snapshots). No UI currently exposes this to users, but storage quota is a real concern especially with canvas snapshots storing base64 images.
existing_patterns: Progress bar styling from existing UI components
code_improvements.implementation_approach: 1. Export a getGlobalStorageStats() function from storageManager.ts that iterates all namespace instances and calls getUsage(). 2. Create StorageUsagePanel.tsx component with progress bars per namespace. 3. Show total usage vs estimated quota (5MB typical). 4. Add clear buttons per namespace calling storage.clear(). 5. Integrate into SettingsModal under a 'Storage' tab or accordion section.
